title: Saturday: two accounts, the new home page, and outreach ready to send
when: Saturday 7 November 2026, 10:55 UTC (for the 12:00 London stand-up)
headline: Since Friday's 18:00 stand-up: 216 releases (v0.1.293 to v0.1.510). The team ran hot on account A, so at Dinis's word it moved to a second account overnight: 23 agents and all of development now run on account B under conductor.b@, every role handed over with a public debrief. The home page is Silvio's mock E, from data, with eight designs to choose from; offline mode and the vault onboarding pool are live; investors@ published four decks. The 50 outreach contact requests sit in the Web Summit team's CRM, waiting for Dinis's yes.
